company.name: Maroo
company.shortDescription: Payments platform for the wedding and events industry
company.description:
Maroo is a payment platform tailored for the wedding and events industry, allowing businesses to manage payments with no processing fees. It supports payment acceptance, branded invoice creation, and payments to freelancers and suppliers. A notable feature is its zero fee model, where fees can be passed onto clients. 

Trusted by over 9,000 businesses, Maroo has facilitated more than $180 million in revenue for its community of event professionals

productsAndServices.description: A payment processing platform enabling wedding and event businesses to send invoices, accept payments via credit cards and ACH transfers, and manage transactions with fee pass-through options.
productsAndServices.name: Maroo Payments

productsAndServices.description: A service allowing clients to pay for wedding and event services over time through installment plans offered by Maroo or partner banks.
productsAndServices.name: Maroo Book Now Pay Later (BNPL)

productsAndServices.description: A tool for vendors to create, manage, and digitally sign contracts with clients and suppliers within the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Contract Management and Digital Signing

productsAndServices.description: A feature enabling vendors to pay freelancers and contractors efficiently, including bulk payment uploads and scheduled disbursements.
productsAndServices.name: Payments to Contractors and Mass Payouts

productsAndServices.description: A centralized system for vendors to organize and manage client contacts and communication within the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Client Management and Contact Book

productsAndServices.description: Options for vendors to customize invoices, payment links, and communications with their own branding and reusable templates.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Branding and Templates
